main.description: One change to a file or folder, written with the node change it records. The record key is a TID made when the change was. It holds the node's state after the change (nothing after a delete). Stored plain or sealed, as a node record is.

node.description: The record key of the node that changed.

change.description: shared: deleted from this space because it moved into a space of its own, to be shared (it's in the mount, not the trash).

device.description: The name of the device that made the change.

prev.description: The version the change was based on. Two versions with the same prev are a race.

sha256.description: Files: SHA-256 of the whole file, in hex.

modifiedAt.description: Files: the file's own modification time.

contentsFrom.description: Files: the version holding this state's chunks, when this one doesn't (a rename or move, or a restore).

chunks.description: Files: the contents, when this version holds them and they fit. Referencing them keeps the blobs for as long as the version is kept.

chunkIDs.description: The IDs that decrypt the chunks, in the same order (32 bytes each, base64 without padding). Absent when the chunks are plain. In a plain record they're readable, so the chunks are too: that only happens after encryption was turned off.

chunkKey.description: The key ID of the drive key the chunk IDs were made with.

continuations.description: How many of this version's app.atdrive.chunks records hold the chunk list, when it's too long for this record.

continuationsFrom.description: The number of the first of those records, when it isn't 1.

sealed.description: On an encrypted drive: every other field, as a JSON object, sealed for this space, collection and record key. The record then has only this and chunks.

mount.description: Mounts: the space that appears here.
